programs.name: init
programs.description: Sets the character up when its script is initialised.

programs.name: reset
programs.description: Puts the character back into its normal state.

programs.name: loop
programs.description: Runs the character's normal behaviour.

programs.name: on_small_damage
programs.description: Reacts to a small hit.

programs.name: on_hold
programs.description: Holds the character in place.

programs.name: on_large_damage
programs.description: Reacts to a large hit.

programs.name: on_melee_hit
programs.description: Follows up a melee hit that the character has landed.

programs.name: on_death
programs.description: Runs the character's death.

programs.name: on_land
programs.description: Lands the character after a fall.

programs.name: init
programs.description: Sets the monster up when it is placed.

programs.name: loop
programs.description: Runs the monster's normal behaviour.

programs.name: on_status_hit
programs.description: Reacts to a hit while greyed out, or to a hit that greys it out.

programs.name: on_damage
programs.description: Reacts to a hit that staggers it.

programs.name: on_knockdown
programs.description: Reacts to a hit that knocks it over.

programs.name: on_guard
programs.description: Guards against a hit.

programs.name: on_dodge_1
programs.description: Dodges the target's first kind of attack.

programs.name: on_dodge_2
programs.description: Dodges the target's second kind of attack.

programs.name: on_death
programs.description: Runs the monster's death.

programs.name: on_caught
programs.description: Reacts to being caught by a frame that lifts it.

programs.name: on_land
programs.description: Lands the monster after it has been thrown.

programs.name: on_stun
programs.description: Stuns the monster.

programs.name: init
programs.description: Initialisation program that every effect script defines empty; the engine never runs it.

programs.name: on_start
programs.description: Runs the effect from the frame it is created.

programs.name: on_finish
programs.description: Ends an effect.
